objectives.description: Add heartbeat_after_phase_transition() function, invoked once after plan_dir resolved/validated, before Phase-not-found exit and idempotency early-exit
Resolve task_dir and read session_id from holder.json via jq
Accept optional 5th positional session_id argument with mismatch trace
Resolve task-lock.sh via deploy-tree-first/source-store-fallback candidate list
Invoke heartbeat and session-heartbeat capturing stderr/exit status
Guard block: no stdout/exit-code effect, PHASE_HEARTBEAT_DISABLE opt-out

manual_smoke_evidence: No .lock/ present: stdout is plan path only, exit 0, noop:no-holder trace lines written for both subcommands.
Real holder.json + session entry: heartbeat_at advanced past acquired_at/started_at on both files after a single call; both trace lines show ok.
5th-arg session-id mismatch: heartbeat NOT applied (holder.json byte-unchanged), noop:session-mismatch trace lines written naming both session ids.
Idempotency early-exit path (status already at target): heartbeat still fires (ok) even though stdout is empty.
Phase-not-found path (phase 9 absent): heartbeat still fires (ok) even though the script exits 1.
PHASE_HEARTBEAT_DISABLE=1: no trace log created at all; script behaves exactly as pre-change.
